name: Nested Core
description: A lit cube suspended inside an open isometric shell, inside a larger wireframe frame. The shell is neutral and the core is the only hue on the page — for runtime, kernel, sandbox and containment stories.

variations.name: default
variations.description: An open cube seen from inside — floor and two far walls, a dotted floor grid, vertex marks — holding a glowing emblem-faced core, with a 1.22x construction frame drawn around the whole scene.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the <svg> root. The artwork is viewBox-driven with no width/height attributes, so it fills its container by default.
